usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named HA rule from the cluster configuration. The rule must already exist (use get_cluster_ha_rules or list_cluster_ha_rules to verify) and the caller must hold the Sys.Console privilege at the root path ('/'). Deletion takes effect immediately with no grace period — any resources currently matched by the rule will fall back to default HA behavior.

examples.summary: Delete an HA location rule named 'prefer-node1'

destructiveReason: The HA rule is permanently removed from cluster configuration; any resource placement or migration preferences it enforced are immediately lost and cannot be recovered without manual recreation.
tips: The 'rule' path param must match a valid pve-configid (alphanumeric and hyphens, no spaces).
Returns null on success — a 404-equivalent error is returned if the rule does not exist.
Changes are cluster-wide and take effect immediately; no node restart or HA manager reload is needed.
Review dependent HA groups or resources before deleting a rule to avoid unexpected migration behavior.
